title: Hammer with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Handle -->
  <rect x="44" y="35" width="12" height="55" rx="4" fill="#c8873a"/>
  <rect x="46" y="35" width="3" height="55" rx="1.5" fill="#e0a94f"/>
  <!-- Handle grip lines -->
  <rect x="44" y="62" width="12" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#a8702e"/>
  <rect x="44" y="70" width="12" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#a8702e"/>
  <rect x="44" y="78" width="12" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#a8702e"/>
  <!-- Hammer head -->
  <rect x="14" y="8" width="72" height="32" rx="8" fill="#9aa4b8"/>
  <rect x="14" y="8" width="72" height="10" rx="6" fill="#b8c2d6"/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <rect x="18" y="12" width="40" height="4" rx="2" fill="#d6dfef"/>
  <!-- Left face cheek -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="28" r="5" fill="#e88a9a"/>
  <!-- Right cheek -->
  <circle cx="70" cy="28" r="5" fill="#e88a9a"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="22" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#2a2a3a"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="22" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#2a2a3a"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="20" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="20" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M40 30 Q50 40 60 30" stroke="#2a2a3a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Little joyful eyebrows -->
  <path d="M33 15 Q38 12 43 15" stroke="#5a5a6a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M57 15 Q62 12 67 15" stroke="#5a5a6a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
